title: OPNsense Health

panels.title: Exporter
panels.description: opnsense-exporter can reach the OPNsense API.

panels.title: mbuf clusters
panels.description: Kernel network buffers; exhaustion drops packets.

panels.title: Peers
panels.description: Handshake age: works whether the API reports an epoch or an age. A peer handshakes every ~2 min while traffic flows.

panels.title: Replies by rcode
panels.description: From the Unbound reply log (Alloy counter). SERVFAIL spikes = upstream/DNSSEC trouble; NXDOMAIN floods = misbehaving client or malware DGA.

targets.expr: topk(25, sum by (qname, rcode, client) (count_over_time({job="opnsense_dns"} | rcode=~"NXDOMAIN|SERVFAIL" [$__range])))

panels.title: ARP entries per interface
panels.description: Devices the firewall currently sees per segment.

panels.title: DHCP messages / min
panels.description: NAK/DECLINE spikes = address conflict or rogue DHCP server; DISCOVERs without OFFERs = pool exhausted.

targets.expr: sum by (host_ip, mac, hostname, iface) (count_over_time({job="opnsense", program=~"dnsmasq.*"} | dhcp_msg="DHCPACK" [$__range]))

panels.title: Authentication / GUI / SSH
panels.description: Needs audit / sshd / lighttpd in System › Settings › Logging › Remote.

description: Gateways, WireGuard, services, firmware, Unbound DNS, pf/mbuf
